overall_summary: FACTVERSE's audience shows a strong preference for extreme, counter-intuitive space and cosmic phenomena over abstract psychology or basic animal facts. Videos featuring physical paradoxes (e.g., burning ice, molten iron rain, oceans in space) drive the highest engagement and views, whereas 'your brain' psychology concepts struggle to gain traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice Will Break Your Brain!' (vWd0uYcEGh4) achieved 1,053 views, and 'The Largest Ocean in Space Will Mind-Blow You!' (6ji74JeS4nE) reached 460 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on space concepts that present an immediate physical contradiction or extreme planetary condition.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Sharks Are Older Than Trees?' (bfT7qzZ6aJQ) generated 302 views, and 'This Animal Literally Dies Every Winter!' (CKI5FRreguM) reached 179 views.
winning_patterns.action: Frame historical and biological facts around mind-bending timeline comparisons or survival extremes.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (Jc04LVKNd2s) got only 17 views, and 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A) got 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic psychological advice or abstract brain functions unless they can be tied to a highly dramatic, tangible consequence.
